## Activity

During December 2024, River Outreach recorded 42 captures as part of its site activity. The activity report provides the basis for reviewing image quality, grading outcomes, and the time taken for images to move through the grading process. The capture total should be considered alongside the quality and grading information below when monitoring service delivery at the site.

## Image quality

Of the 42 captures, 5 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 11.9%. Images recorded as ungradable could not proceed through grading and should be considered in the site’s ongoing review of image acquisition and equipment performance. Any recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 2 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 0 days, indicating no median delay during the reporting period. The grading result and the image-quality findings should be reviewed together to support routine monitoring of the service and to identify any operational issues requiring follow-up.
